name: michael-han-il
description: Mike Han's Claude plugins: turn recorded talks and lectures into transcript + slides PDFs.

plugins.name: youtube-talk-to-pdf
plugins.description: Turn a YouTube talk or lecture into a readable PDF: local Whisper transcript, LLM punctuation and paragraphs, and the presentation slides placed where they were shown. Any language, with extra Chinese support (Traditional or Simplified, Taiwan/Hong Kong character forms, full-width punctuation). Apple Silicon, Intel Mac, Windows or Linux.
